description: Creates a virtual tape with a user-defined barcode on a Tape Gateway (VTL). A virtual tape is stored in Amazon S3 and can be archived to S3 Glacier or S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with the virtual tape.

Key.description: The tag key. Cannot be prefixed with aws:.
Key.markdownDescription:
The tag key. Cannot be prefixed with aws:.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 128  
Pattern: ^([\p{L}\p{Z}\p{N}_.:/=+\-@]*)$  
Update requires: No interruption

Value.markdownDescription:
The tag value.

Required: Yes

Maximum Length: 256  
Update requires: No interruption

Maximum Length: 500

KMSEncrypted.markdownDescription:
